title: Finite scalar coherence of normalized intrinsic adic fibres
statement: For any scheme W, geometric point x over an algebraically closed field [def-weil-geometric-point], and algebraic closure Qbar of Q_l, let G_L be rational fibre functors on the rational constructible category [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] at each finite coefficient field L [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set] whose restriction to integral constructible objects [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed] is completed pullback followed by H^0, point sections and inversion of the uniformizer [def-pur-completed-coefficient-presentation-transport]. Extend G_L to Qbar along the actual transported field inclusion. These functors admit natural transition isomorphisms satisfying the cocycle for the normalized stage associator [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. This is finite scalar compatibility only; it does not assert existence of a functor on the common-stage category.

proof.text: Compare the normalized coefficient model with the ordinary completed module model. At the point, evaluation of the constant-to-completion map is the actual integer coefficient inclusion.

proof.text: Finite free scalar tensor commutes with completed pullback, homology in degree zero and point sections. On K-flat representatives the normalized maps take a pure tensor to its point section.

proof.text: Balanced tensor associativity proves the comparison cocycle on pure tensors. Naturality and localization extend it to rational fractions. The coefficient embeddings compose, so extension to the closure field gives the stated cocone for the recorded stage system.

theorem sfAdicFiniteFiberCocone
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (W : Scheme.{u})
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ W)
    (Qbar : Type v) [Field Qbar] [Algebra (Padic l) Qbar]
    [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Qbar]
    (G : ∀ L : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Qbar,
      sfRationalConstructibleCategory l
        (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Qbar L) W ⥤
          ModuleCat.{u + 1} (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Qbar L))
    (hG : ∀ L, sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l
        (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Qbar L) W ⋙ G L =
      (sfIntegralConstructible l
        (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Qbar L) W).ι ⋙
        (purCoefficientModel l
          (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Qbar L) W).inverse ⋙
        pbcActualCompletedPull x (pbcIntegralDatum l
          (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Qbar L)) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ 0 ⋙
        PerAdic.pointSections l
          (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Qbar L) Ω ⋙
        ModuleCat.extendScalars (PerAdic.integerToField l
          (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Qbar L))) :
    let Φ := fun L : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Qbar ↦ G L ⋙
      ModuleCat.extendScalars
        (L.val.subtype.comp (Shrink.algEquiv (Padic l) L.val).toRingHom)
    let S := GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Qbar W
    ∃ β : ∀ {L M : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Qbar} (h : L ≤ M),
        S.T h ⋙ Φ M ≅ Φ L,
      ∀ {L M N : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Qbar} (h : L ≤ M) (k : M ≤ N)
        (K : GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage l Qbar W L),
        (Φ N).map ((S.assoc h k).hom.app K) ≫ (β (h.trans k)).hom.app K =
          (β k).hom.app ((S.T h).obj K) ≫ (β h).hom.app K
